content:
maria: Quick sync - thinking through safer ways to route OTLP spans so we can produce per-customer datasets without touching the ingest DB.
ken: +1. Are we leaning header-based routing (x-tenant-id) or resource attribute based? Both have tradeoffs.
sophia: Header-based is easiest for SDK customers, but we need to ensure proxies preserve that header and it's authenticated.
liam: Resource attribute (resource.attributes.service.namespace or service.instance.id) fits OTel semantics, and collectors already map fields, but it's easier to spoof.
maria: Main goals: immutable per-tenant dataset, RBAC on exports, per-tenant retention tiers, minimal perf impact.
jordan: For RBAC I want token-scoped scopes: exporter token includes allowed namespaces. Then collector enforces at ingress.
maria: That implies a token + header approach: Auth via bearer token -> collector assigns tenant_id and drops any conflicting header from client.
ken: I sketched an otel-collector pipeline snippet to validate tokens and set resource:
```
receivers: otlp:
  protocols:
    grpc: {}
processors:
  authvalidator:
    token_source: /etc/collector/tenant-jwks.json
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: tenant_id
        action: insert
        from_attribute: "auth.tenant"
exporters:
  kafka:
    topic: spans-${tenant_id}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [authvalidator, attributes]
      exporters: [kafka]
```
sophia: Nice. Two concerns: 1) kafka topic explosion if we create one per tenant, 2) backpressure + partitioning.
liam: For 1) we can use tenant sharding: topic per shard, with tenant key in message and a routing layer to isolate in storage. Or use tenant prefix and compaction to group small tenants.
jordan: Retention - enterprise customers want longer retention. We should add retention metadata to a management API and have a rewriter job that moves data to cold storage after X days per-tenant.
maria: Agree. Need to make sure RBAC prevents cross-tenant queries in dashboards. Console queries must pass tenant-scoped tokens and collectors must tag all spans with tenant_id at ingest.
ken: UX question: how will console show a single org with multiple internal namespaces? We should surface 'dataset' and 'namespace' separately: dataset = tenant, namespace = logical subteam.
sophia: Also: sampling config. Per-tenant sampling must be enforced close to ingest to avoid wasted egress cost. Add per-tenant sampler in collector with remote-config controlled by management API.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Started rollout of collector-auth-validator v1.2 to canary cluster at 2024-10-11T15:04:12Z :rocket:
liam: For migration, plan: 1) start enforcing auth on new ingestion endpoints 2) accept both header and resource.attr but canonicalize to collector-assigned tenant_id 3) run a verifier job to flag mismatches 4) after 30 days, drop legacy route.
maria: Sounds good. Action items: ken -> prototype collector pipeline and token validator. jordan -> retention policy API sketch + migration job. sophia -> sampling + console query guardrails. I'll coordinate with security on token format.
ken: I'll post a PR with a minimal PoC tomorrow. Expect logs and a short e2e using a test tenant.
sophia: If possible include a small dashboard mock for console showing tenant filter and retention controls.
maria: Thanks everyone. We'll sync in engineering sync Friday. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: collector-auth-validator v1.2 rolled out to canary. No errors in 2h.
ops-bot: infra-alert: kafka topic retention increased for shard-03 as part of test run.
liam: small note — we must ensure GDPR customers can opt for on-prem export; add to design doc.
maria: noted. I'll add that to the design doc and TAG ops/security.
